editorial:
Imagine taking a trip to fix your marriage, only for your partner to vanish into thin air. That is exactly what happens to Eric and Mari. They head to the southeast of Mexico hoping to save their relationship, but things take a dark turn when Mari disappears. You will spend most of the movie riding along with Eric as he heads back to Mexico City. Along the way, he picks up a strange guy named Narciso. The vibe is very tense and mysterious, making you feel like something is off from the very first scene. You get to hear Eric explain the events of the trip, but you start to realize that he might not be telling you the whole truth.

The acting is solid and keeps you guessing about who to trust. While the story moves a bit slow at times, the big payoff at the end makes it worth your while. If you like movies that play tricks on your mind, you should definitely give this one a try.
endingExplained: The big twist is that Mari did not just disappear; Eric actually killed her during their trip. He spent the whole movie lying to Narciso and the audience to make himself look like a victim. Narciso is not just a random stranger, but someone who helps Eric face the truth. In the end, Eric has to admit what he did, showing that the whole journey was about his guilt and his crimes.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological twists and slow-burn mysteries.
